scripts.install:all: concurrently --names server-install,client-install "npm install --prefix server" "npm install --prefix client/vite-project"
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names server,client "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client/vite-project run dev"
scripts.install:vercel: npm ci --prefix server && npm ci --prefix client/vite-project
